// Vendored snapshot. Do not edit — re-export instead.

{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.82

|gr1= Lights

|gr2= Diagnostic

|descr= Overrides currently used scene lighting. The operand is config that is placed as a string (not file).
The changes may not be applied immediately, but can be forced by the call of [[simulWeatherSync]].

|s1= [[diag_setLightNew]] config

|p1= config: [[String]] - config in string form

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>diag_setLightNew "sunOrMoon = 1; diffuse[] = { 0, 0, 0, 0 }; diffuseCloud[] = { 0, 0, 0, 0 }; ambient[] = { 0, 0, 0, 0 }; ... ";</sqf>

|seealso= [[diag_lightNewLoad]]
}}

{{Note
|user= POLPOX
|timestamp= 20230514105007
|text= The change is permanent (you can see the change even after you change the mission/terrain.) However, you can send an empty string to reset the lighting.
}}
